newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rising marginally.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rising marginally.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to rise marginally on Thursday ahead of the weekend, brokers said.
"More fresh commitments are expected as prices of many a blue chip turned attractive during a bear-run in recent sessions," said broker Mahbub Morshed.

Brokers said blue chip shares in engineering, pharmaceutical and food sectors might be particularly attractive. They said Singer Bangladesh, Apex Food and Beximco Pharma might rise on basically retail buying.
The DSE all share price index gained 1.07 percent to 1,123.47 on turnover of 48.5 million taka on Wednesday.
